name: Salmon and Potato Salad
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Dice the potatoes and boil them in salted water for 12 minutes until tender, then drain and leave to steam dry.
Put the salmon on a lined tray, brush with the oil and season. Bake for 12 minutes until it flakes easily.
Slice the cucumber and half the lemon, and tip the salad leaves into a bowl.
Flake the salmon over the potatoes, cucumber and salad leaves, squeeze over the lemon and serve.
